VRT.title: VRT Series Packaged Rooftop Unit — Gas Heat / Electric Cooling
text_facts: Filters should be inspected monthly during the cooling season and replaced at least every 3 months.
The condenser coil must be cleaned at least once a year.
The unit is not approved for installation on roofs with a slope greater than 1/4 in. per foot unless a level curb is used.

bulletins.title: VRT-060 condenser fan motor run capacitor — early failures
bulletins.applies_to: VRT-060 units with serial numbers 2307V00001 through 2312V99999
facts: Original condenser fan run capacitor is rated 5 µF / 370 VAC and can swell and lose capacitance after one to two cooling seasons.
Replace with upgraded capacitor part number VPN-0475 (5 µF / 440 VAC).
A weak capacitor reduces condenser fan speed, which raises head pressure on hot days and can cause high-pressure switch trips.

bulletins.title: VRL-150 condenser fan blade inspection
facts: Inspect condenser fan blades for hairline cracks at the hub during every spring start-up.
Replace cracked blades with fan blade kit VPN-6120; torque hub set screws to 160 in-lb.
Do not operate the unit with a cracked blade.

bulletins.title: A2L refrigerant detection system — field service guidance
facts: When the refrigerant detection sensor senses a leak, the board shuts off the compressor and runs the indoor blower continuously (mitigation mode).
Mitigation mode continues for at least 5 minutes after the sensor reading clears.
Never bypass or jumper the refrigerant detection sensor.

calls.topic: Repeated high-pressure lockouts on hot afternoons
must_say: firmware two point three
no debounce on the high-pressure switch input
locks out hard after three trips in one hour
fixed in firmware two point four point one
update it with the service app over the USB-C port
check the condenser fan capacitor

calls.topic: Heat pump defrost not terminating
must_say: the A version of the defrost sensor drifts low after about two years
part number V-P-N forty-four seventy-one B
the B version supersedes the A version

calls.topic: Compressor hums but will not start
must_say: the only approved hard start kit is the V-H-S thirty-five
a generic kit with a start capacitor over two hundred microfarads voids the compressor warranty

calls.topic: Second stage of cooling never energizes
must_say: factory stage delay is ten minutes
DIP switch four
turn DIP switch four on to cut it to three minutes

calls.topic: Air handler blower runs constantly
must_say: the G relay on the V-A-B fifty board can weld closed
replacement board kit V-P-N fifty-five twenty
check for twenty-four volts at G with the thermostat off

calls.topic: Flame rollout switch tripping
must_say: bird nests blocking the inducer venturi
common on the twenty twenty-two builds

calls.topic: Auxiliary heat not coming on
must_say: only the fifteen kilowatt kit has a manual reset limit
it is behind access panel four

calls.topic: Low-pressure trips while cooling a server room in winter
must_say: you need the low ambient kit V-L-A two

calls.topic: Economizer damper not modulating
must_say: the actuator needs a two to ten volt signal
the board ships in zero to ten volt mode

calls.topic: Condensate overflow switch tripping with dry pan
must_say: on the oh-three-six built before week forty of twenty twenty-two the float switch is mounted too low

calls.topic: Compressor warranty question
must_say: ten year compressor warranty if the unit is registered within sixty days

calls.topic: Heat pump heats when calling for cooling

calls.topic: Phase monitor nuisance trips
must_say: factory unbalance trip is ten percent

calls.topic: Pairing a condenser with an air handler — metering device
must_say: the V-C-U oh-two-four ships with a fixed orifice
with the V-A-H oh-two-four you install TXV kit V-T-X two

calls.topic: Electric heat staging timing
must_say: the V-A-B fifty board stages the heat strips thirty seconds apart

calls.topic: Gas valve has 24 volts but no flame
must_say: igniter part V-P-N eleven ninety
forty to seventy-five ohms cold

calls.topic: Defrost interval for a snowy site
must_say: in heavy snow we recommend thirty minutes instead of the default sixty

calls.topic: Unit will not start after a winter power outage

after a cold power-up below fifty degrees outside

calls.topic: Follow-up after firmware update and capacitor replacement

calls.topic: Slow refrigerant leak search

calls.topic: Rattling noise from air handler

calls.topic: Refrigerant detection sensor fault, blower will not shut off
